title: No Edges, No Verdict: A Large-Scale Empirical Study of Declared Dependency Graphs in 78K SBOMs in the Wild
abstract: arXiv:2607.22140v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Software Bills of Materials (SBOMs) are consumed not only as component inventories but as dependency graphs: vulnerability triage, reachability filtering, and impact analysis all traverse the edges an SBOM declares. We present the first large-scale characterization of the declared dependency graph across 78,612 real-world SBOM files from the Wild SBOMs dataset (77,092 parseable). We find that the population splits into three regimes: 52.9% of SBOMs declare no edges at all (failing the NTIA minimum-elements requirement of dependency relationships), 8.8% declare a dependency block yet leave the majority of components isolated (degenerate regime; among such SBOMs with at least 50 components the median orphan share is 93%, and our 11 Syft-generated container-image SBOMs fall in this regime at 91.4-98.0% orphans), and 38.3% form well-connected graphs. translated_title: 无边缘，无判定：对78K个真实世界SBOM中声明依赖图的大规模实证研究
translated_abstract: 软件物料清单（SBOM）不仅作为组件清单被使用，还作为依赖图：漏洞分类、可达性过滤和影响分析都遍历SBOM声明的边缘。我们对来自Wild SBOMs数据集（77,092个可解析）的78,612个真实世界SBOM文件中的声明依赖图进行了首次大规模特征化分析。我们发现总体分为三个区间：52.9%的SBOM未声明任何边缘（不符合NTIA关于依赖关系的最低要素要求），8.8%声明了依赖块但使大多数组件孤立（退化区间；在此类至少含50个组件的SBOM中，中位孤立比例为93%，我们生成的11个Syft容器镜像SBOM也属于此区间，孤立比例为91.4-98.0%），38.3%形成了良好连接的图。边缘生成由生成器决定，而非所描述的软件（0%-100%无边缘）。
tldr: 这项研究首次大规模分析了78,612个真实SBOM中的依赖图，发现超过半数未声明任何边缘，且边缘生成主要由生成器决定而非软件本身，这对漏洞分析有重要影响。
en_tdlr: This study is the first large-scale analysis of dependency graphs in 78,612 real-world SBOMs, revealing that over half declare no edges and edge generation is determined by the generator rather than the software itself, with significant implications for vulnerability analysis.
